name: MWFIT1-the-hide-under-nothing

new: for (const h of p.hides ?? []) claim(ARMO_PART.findIndex((r) => r.name === h), prio, null);

name: MWFIT1-the-slot-forgets-what-it-lies-under
old: slot.prio = prio; slot.add = add; slot.shadow = true; slot.under = under;
new: slot.prio = prio; slot.add = add; slot.shadow = true;

name: MWFIT1-a-robe-over-the-pauldron-keeps-its-exemption
old: slot.prio = prio; slot.add = add; slot.shadow = true; slot.under = under;
new: slot.prio = prio; slot.add = add; slot.shadow = true; slot.under = under ?? slot.under;
why: Unreachable through the walk: the pieces are claimed in the reference's slotlist order (wornOrder - the robe and the skirt first), every own model claims at an armour's priority, and a later claim at that priority loses the strictly-greater gate - so nothing ever claims over a pauldron's hide. Clearing `under` on every claim is kept so a slot owns no stale exemption if that order ever changes.
